paper.title: Mapping Natural Language Instructions to Mobile UI Action Sequences
paper.central_claim: 提出“把自然语言指令落地为移动 UI 动作序列”的新问题并构建三个数据集（PixelHelp、AndroidHowTo、RicoSCA）；用 Transformer 抽取动作短语元组，再用 Transformer 屏幕编码器把对象描述落地到屏幕元素，完整动作序列匹配达到 70.59%（PixelHelp）。（同时是资源论文，但中心可检验主张是该两步模型在 PixelHelp 上的结果。）
paper.claim_type_reason: Final: component_training. The tested claim is a decoupled data/training recipe for a phrase-extraction + screen-grounding component evaluated offline against reference sequences (agg:S-A06); no closed-loop success is claimed or measured, so system_method would judge it against an outcome it never claims. Dataset contributions are noted but the central claim is the trained component's accuracy.

provenance.independence_note: Aggregation over two seat inputs; the fixed paper text was read in full before the seat scores, but this is not a third blind review or human gold. All results are author reports; nothing was reproduced.

preliminary_evidence_judgment: Read before seat scores. Seq2Act defines instruction-to-mobile-UI-action grounding, builds PixelHelp (187 human-executed tasks on an emulator, test only), AndroidHowTo (span-annotated web how-tos) and RicoSCA (295K template commands synthesised from Rico view hierarchies), and trains a phrase-tuple extractor plus a Transformer screen encoder that selects view-hierarchy objects. Evaluation is offline complete/partial match against one recorded reference sequence (70.59%/89.21%); predicted actions are never executed although the emulator setup existed. Screen-encoder comparison (heuristic, two GCNs, Transformer) holds the frozen extractor fixed; t-test over 5 runs without variances. No end-to-end or no-synthetic-data control. An early design choice (not grounding from decoder hidden state q_j) was informed by PixelHelp performance, i.e. the test set was consulted during design. Claim is a training/data recipe for a grounding component, not closed-loop success.

scope_decision.reason: Mobile GUI instruction grounding model and datasets usable as a CUA component; offline evaluation.

signatures.object: 指令→动作序列的两阶段映射（短语元组抽取 + 屏幕对象 grounding）
signatures.information: 指令文本；每步的屏幕视图层级(对象名称、类型、边框坐标、树结构)；不使用像素。测试时每步屏幕 s_j 来自 PixelHelp 标注轨迹的记录。
signatures.operation: (1) 6 层 Transformer 编码-解码器输出每步 [操作, 对象, 参数] 三个 span（pointer 式、sum-pooling 等 span 表示）；(2) grounding：对象描述向量与 Transformer 屏幕编码的各对象向量做点积 softmax，选对象 ID；操作由描述 span 的前馈网络决定；参数直接取参数 span。
signatures.output: 可执行动作序列 [操作, 对象 ID, 参数]。

signatures.selection_data: AndroidHowTo(8K/1K/900) 与 RicoSCA 训练/验证
signatures.later_use: 推理时在新指令上使用。

gap.author_gap: 把多步自然语言指令映射为可执行的移动 UI 动作需要“指令-动作-屏幕”配对数据，规模化收集困难；此前落地工作多在桌面/网页，缺移动端数据与方法。
gap.checked_gap: “配对数据难以规模收集”只是作者断言(EV12)，没有成本量化；“移动端缺方法”有叙述性比较(EV32)，未做与近邻方法的实验对比。另一处可核实的瓶颈：隐状态 grounding 在合成数据上过拟合(EV23)，级联错误(EV24)。因此为“部分核实”。

claims.text: PixelHelp 完整任务评测：Transformer 屏幕编码器 70.59% 完整/89.21% 部分匹配，优于 Distance GCN、Filter-1 GCN 与 BLEU 启发式。

claims.selection_vs_test: PixelHelp 仅测试；hyperparameter 在 AndroidHowTo/RicoSCA 验证集调
claims.result_denominator: 187 任务；5 次运行 t 检验 p<0.05；无区间

claims.text: 把问题分解为短语抽取+grounding，并用合成命令训练 grounding，使得无需配对数据即可落地真实指令。
claims.baseline_control: 无（无端到端/无合成对照）

assessment.evidence_level_reason: Step-wise matching against one recorded human sequence on PixelHelp; predicted actions are not executed.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported: a phrase-extractor + Transformer screen-encoder trained only on AndroidHowTo spans and RicoSCA synthetic commands reaches 70.59% complete / 89.21% partial reference-sequence match on the held-out PixelHelp (187 tasks), above heuristic and GCN encoders with the extractor fixed (t-test over 5 runs). Executability, necessity of decomposition or synthetic data, and robustness beyond 4 Google-app categories are not shown.
not_supported: Synthetic data better than or equivalent to paired data
unresolved: Whether test-time screens are recorded (teacher-forced) or produced by predicted actions
App overlap between Rico and PixelHelp
assessment.retention_trace: No retained-improvement claim; static trained weights.

G.reason: New, meaningful problem (accessibility/situational impairment) and a clear task definition; the paired-data-scarcity premise is asserted rather than quantified and neighbours are listed in one sentence without comparison.

M.reason: Decoupling maps one-to-one onto available data sources; contextual encoder value supported by GCN comparisons; assumptions stated; no evidence that the decomposition itself helps.

X.reason: Data construction, model equations, training settings, annotation interface and hyperparameters are given; failure modes (cascades, hidden-state transfer failure) and exclusions stated; test-time screen transition not specified; Appendix B algorithm bodies unrendered.

E.measurement.reason: Single-reference step matching without execution; valid alternative paths count as errors; AndroidHowTo test restricted to full-agreement items; PixelHelp scope narrowed by exclusions.

E.causality.reason: Encoder comparison with fixed extractor and equal-parameter GCNs plus span-representation comparison; no decomposition-vs-end-to-end, no-synthetic or data-scale ablation for the central recipe.

E.holdout.reason: PixelHelp is formally test-only and from a different source, but it was consulted during design exploration (agg:S-A01), app overlap with Rico is not audited, and the claim scope (executable actions) exceeds the offline test.

E.statistics.reason: t-test over 5 runs for Table 2 but no spread/CI shown; 14/187 phrase-failure breakdown; no test for Table 1, single 187-task set without per-category results.

E.cost.reason: Training compute/time reported (V100, 28-30 h, 250K grounding steps); no inference latency or comparison with alternatives; synthesis/annotation cost not quantified.

score.formula: S=(15G+25M+20X+10Emeas+10Ecaus+10Ehold+5Estat+5Ecost)/4; unknown -> L uses 0, U uses 4; raw=null while any unknown

status_reason: Full fixed HTML text available and read (figure images are captions only); in scope per scope_decision; all eight items resolved.
aggregate_session_note: Configured model type fable (upstream claude-opus-5-5[1m]) per batch manifest model_types.opus55; no session id or invocation receipt is exposed to this agent.

resolutions.reason: The tested claim is a data/training recipe for a grounding component evaluated offline (agg:S-A06); no closed-loop outcome is claimed. Under SCORE_SPEC, component_training evaluates interface, data, training and component effect without extrapolating to whole-agent capability, which matches what PixelHelp measures.
resolutions.score_impact: none on ratings (both seats' agreed ratings already judge offline component evidence)

resolutions.reason: The paper's stated approach is the factorisation into extraction and grounding joined by a structured tuple, which is what enables decoupled data; template synthesis serves the grounding half and is kept as supporting. Both are partial fits.
Synthetic supervision is a distinct operation from the decomposition and needs its own entry.
Keep son55's decomposition match (sub null) and sol's synthetic-supervision match with sub null: C08's load-bearing quality gate/curator is absent (screens are pre-filtered, commands are not gated).
Union: each card describes a different executed operation (offline step evaluation, structure-derived grounding data, element-id selection, describe-then-ground split).

Formal test-only use of PixelHelp (agg:S-A02) is offset by its consultation during design (agg:S-A01), unaudited Rico/PixelHelp app overlap and claim scope beyond the offline test; son55's 3 credits the formal split only.
A t-test over 5 runs without visible spread, one 187-task set and an untested Table 1 is anchor 2 ('relevant results, statistical gaps remain'), not near-anchor-4.

Neither n/a (the paper calls PixelHelp full-task evaluation) nor a pure anachronism challenge: the publication-time equivalent (executing predictions on the emulator used for recording) was feasible and not done.

No claim to beat prior GUI grounders; comparisons are the paper's own encoder variants. Named benchmarks/baselines postdate the paper and are not demanded (publication-time rule); the publication-time equivalent is judged.

The grounding component's contribution to full-sequence accuracy is claimed and tested by holding the extractor fixed and swapping grounders (agg:S-A04), the E08 design; the split itself is not compared with an unsplit model.
All compared models use the same view-hierarchy observation; no differing-observation comparison exists.
No robustness-across-layout claim is made; sol's unmet assumes a claim the paper does not state.

PixelHelp excludes instructions needing user input or physical buttons by construction, so the benchmark contains no ambiguous/infeasible items and no refusal claim is made; the exclusion is recorded as scope narrowing under E.holdout/E.measurement instead.
RicoSCA is single-step template synthesis with no claim of being better than an alternative synthesis recipe; the missing no-synthetic control is assessed under E.causality.
